summary: The base container that carries background, border, blur, and elevation.
purpose: Use as the foundation under any card, panel, or grouped region. Reach for it instead of a raw Box or MUI Paper so glass, radius, and depth come from tokens and stay consistent across the system.

anatomy.description: A Box that applies the variant fill, border, radius, and elevation shadow.
children render inside; Surface adds no padding of its own.

props.name: variant
props.description: The fill treatment: translucent blurred glass, an opaque canvas fill, or a borderless tint.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Depth via shadow: none, a resting card shadow, or a modal-level shadow.

props.name: sx
props.description: MUI style overrides; inherited from BoxProps, use for layout not for restyling the surface.

props.name: ...BoxProps
props.description: All MUI Box props pass through (component, onClick, ref, and layout props).

variants.name: glass
variants.description: Translucent surface fill with a medium backdrop blur and a subtle border.
variants.whenToUse: The default. Cards and panels that sit over the app background.

variants.name: solid
variants.description: Opaque canvas fill with a subtle border, no blur.
variants.whenToUse: When content behind must be fully hidden or blur would hurt legibility.

variants.name: subtle
variants.description: Light glass tint with no border.
variants.whenToUse: Quiet grouping where a hard edge would be too much.

whenToUse: Wrapping a card, panel, dialog body, or any grouped region.
Establishing depth in a stack of layered content.

whenNotToUse.scenario: A full opinionated card with header, body, and actions
A modal shell with backdrop and focus trap

do: Let the variant and elevation set fill, border, and shadow.
Add your own padding via sx, since Surface ships none.
Nest content components inside rather than restyling Surface itself.
dont: Hardcode a background, border, or box-shadow that a variant already provides.
Stack floating elevation on many surfaces at once; reserve it for what truly lifts.

content.voice: n/a; Surface is a container and holds no copy of its own.

tokensUsed.usage: Backdrop blur on the glass variant.
Border on the glass and solid variants.

keyboard: No interaction of its own; the content inside owns keyboard behavior.
aria: Purely presentational by default; give it a role only if it becomes an interactive region.
accessibility.contrast: Content placed on the surface must clear 4.5:1 against the chosen variant fill.
accessibility.focus: No focus target of its own; focus lives with the content inside.

related.whenToChoose: Use FeatureCard for a titled marketing card; Surface is the raw container beneath it.
Use Dialog for a modal shell; Surface is only the container primitive.
